name: Flame Lance · Death · Lightning
primary:
A beam to the aim point hits everyone along it. In instant mode it keeps firing while held. Effects:
• Damage 6.25 ❤ fire + 3 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 32.4 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
